newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed contrast medium approved in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed contrast medium approved in Europe.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceuticals company Nycomed ASA said on Wednesday its Teslascan (mangafodipir), a contrast medium for the liver and pancreas, had been approved for marketing in the European Union.
Nycomed said in a statement that Teslascan was the company's first organ-specific contrast agent for use in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

"Teslascan will increase the usefulness of MRI as a diagnostic method, enabling MRI in many cases to be used as a substitute or follow-up for computed tomography (CT), which is the imaging technique most often used today for liver indications," the company said.

The marketing authorisation is valid for all European Union countries while in the United States, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued an "approvable" letter for Teslascan, the statement said.
"In view of the diagnostic potential of Teslascan for the diagnosis of liver diseases, Nycomed expects to obtain a considerable market share in this relatively specific market," the company said.
It said it will start marketing Teslascan in the third quarter of this year.
